$description: Measured border radii. Nested surfaces are concentric: inner radius = outer radius - padding (26-8=18, 26-10=16).

lg.use: Menu rows, small inner cards, compare chips, glass inner rows

4xl.use: Inner card inside a frame, accordion item, large glass panel

5xl.use: Side nav card, toast, chat bubble

frame.use: Outer frame card that wraps an inner surface

pill.use: Buttons, pills, tags, segmented controls, dots, round avatars

bubble.use: Quote bubble with one tight corner pointing at the author
